messages:
maria: opened SDK PR #1023 that depends on API change in https://github.com/redwood-inc/api/pull/814 — the api change adds the 'model_variant' query param. Need sequencing advice on merge order.
dan: noted. @tyler any blockers from API side? is this breaking for existing clients?
tyler: the param is optional and behind a feature flag, not breaking. i do need to review the swagger diff though — can you post it? might want a quick contract test run.
maria: swagger diff here: https://gist.github.com/maria/7c4f2d — also sdk uses the new field parsing in parser.go (small change). won't surface until SDK bump.
ci-bot: sdk/integration-tests — FAILED
```
# failure snippet
--- FAIL: TestModelRouting (0.23s)
    routing_test.go:42: expected route for variant `fast` but got `standard`
```
jen: i can triage the integration flake, looks like a nondeterministic test. i'll rerun the job and try a local reproduce.
shawn: heads up — runtime helm needs a chart bump for the new canary image tag. i opened runtime/helm PR #56 to update image tag and values. without that the runtime will fallback to old routing and we'll see mismatch.
dan: suggested sequencing: 1) merge api change + run contract tests, 2) merge runtime/helm PR and deploy canary, 3) merge sdk PR and cut release. who needs to approve each?
tyler: i'll merge the api change once contract tests are green. need a QA sign-off before merging to main.
maria: will wait for helm PR to merge before tagging sdk. can we target a merge window today 15:00-16:00 PT?
jen: +1, i'll babysit CI during that window and coordinate QA smoke.
dan: i'll add a temporary merge hold and notify the eng-platform channel when we can go. @shawn can you confirm the helm canary will be up by 15:30? :thumbsup:
shawn: yes aiming for 15:15 canary ready, will post the deployment URL.
tyler: once smoke passes i can approve api PR.
maria: thanks — i'll queue sdk PR and keep manifest changes minimal. pls ping here when each step completes.
jen: rerun triggered: https://ci.redwood.dev/job/12345 — i'll report back with results.
ci-bot: sdk/integration-tests — SUCCESS on rerun 12345
maria: great, tagging the sdk branch for merge readiness.
dan: tracking doc: https://docs.internal.redwood/merge-windows/sdk-api-staggered-2026-03 — i'll update with final timings.
shawn: runtime helm merged, canary URL: https://canary.runtime.redwood/ — performing basic smoke now.
tyler: smoke looks good from API side, QA queued for sign-off.
jen: QA passed basic flows, leaving an approval in the api PR.
dan: all green, removing merge hold and going to merge in order: api -> helm -> sdk. i'll post updates.
maria: merging sdk after helm propagation. thanks everyone! :rocket:
